description: Retrieve full details for a single device by its numeric ID. Returns device identity and display names, online/offline status, approval status, network info (IP addresses, MAC addresses, DNS name, NetBIOS name), assigned owner, parent device, organization, location, node class, role, policies, backup usage statistics, backup bandwidth throttle settings, warranty dates, maintenance status, custom tags, and user-defined data.
example_queries: look up a device by ID
fetch information about a specific machine
show me a device's status and owner
what organization does this device belong to
is this device online or offline
get backup usage for a device
what policy is assigned to this device
get maintenance status for a machine
find the assigned technician for a device

description: Retrieve a list of all users. Returns each user's identity details (ID, UID, first/last name, email, phone), account status (enabled, administrator, must-change-password, MFA configured), client access and notification permissions, user type, invitation status, associated organization, assigned/associated device IDs, and assigned roles.
example_queries: find devices assigned to a user
which users have not changed their password
find users with client notification permissions

description: Retrieve a list of all organizations. Returns each organization's ID, name, description, user-defined data, and node approval mode (how newly discovered devices are approved into the organization).
example_queries: get user-defined data for an organization

description: Retrieve a list of all policies. Returns each policy's ID, parent policy ID (for inheritance), name, description, applicable node class, last updated timestamp, and whether it is the default policy for its node class.
example_queries: what is the default policy for Windows servers
find the parent policy of a policy
when was a policy last updated
list policies for a specific node class
